other_conditions: Applicant must be a close relative of the deceased (Spouse, Son, Daughter, Parent, Brother, Grandson).
Applicant must provide a self‑declaration that they are the legal heir of the deceased.
Applicant must not have received any amount under any other government scheme for the same purpose.
Eligibility category noted in source: Brahmin
benefits_summary: Financial assistance of ₹10,000 for funeral expenses.
